items.title: Watch the Path of Exile 1 ExileCon Qualifier Tomorrow - Earn Twitch Drops
items.excerpt: The first ExileCon Path of Exile 1 Qualifier begins tomorrow! Tune in to https://www.twitch.tv/pathofexile at 2 PM PDT on September 3 to watch the action live and acquire a reward doing so! Twitch Drops will be available for 24 hours once the broadcast begins. Watch the official race or any Path of Exile 1 stream for 30 minutes to receive the Wild Footprints Effect. items.title: Path of Exile 1 Build Showcase: Luminary Facebreaker
items.excerpt: Turn your fists into the heaviest matter in Wraeclast with today's Build Showcase episode. This Luminary Facebreaker build by Alohaa features the new Scion Ascendancy and relies on a specific Mercenary for its core interaction. Check it out! Thanks to Alohaa for putting this build together. For more information, refer to their video guide here. See you next time!

items.title: Path of Exile 2's first event league goes 'oops, all bosses' and reworks its worst mode so sane people can finally enjoy it
items.excerpt: fter the tremendous Return of the Ancients update to Path of Exile 2, it wouldn't take much to convince me to play more of it. The action RPG is the best it's ever been and finally feels ready to come out later this year. So when developer Grinding Gear Games says it's dropping a new mini-league next week to fill some time before release, you can bet I'll be there... Read more.

items.title: Path of Exile 2 is finally getting swords in December, and also the rest of the game
items.excerpt: It's finally time for the one thing every Path of Exile 2 player has been waiting for: swords. A new class and weapon type is coming to the action RPG later this year—oh, and the full 1.0 release of the game... Read more.

items.excerpt: It’s finally happening! items.title: Path of Exile 1 Build Showcase: Spinning Magma Saboteur
items.excerpt: If you like spicy, but spin-worthy builds, check out the Spinning Magma Saboteur build by Zurku351! It revolves around one thing though: a whole lot of magma! Using a combination of Cyclone, Cast While Channelling & Rolling Magma - start spinning, and let the magma do the rest! Thanks to Zurku351 for putting this build together. For more information, refer to their guide here. See you next time!

items.title: The Last of the Druids Microtransactions Are Now Available in Store
items.excerpt: Microtransactions from the Last of the Druids Mystery Box have finally been released in the store for Path of Exile 1 and Path of Exile 2! From Armour Sets to Portals and Level-Up Effects, there are over 60 new microtransactions available, giving you even more ways to customise your Exile and show off your style. Check out the full selection in the store, or watch the video below to take a closer look at everything included in the Last of the Druids Mystery Box. Thank you for your support!
